provenance.qualification: Synthetic complete-tree reconstruction; no authoritative whole-archive SHA-256 is available, so this digest identifies the synthetic container rather than the removed wordpress.org ZIP.

base.note: The SVN revision is the retained complete manifest: it names every file in the tree at that revision.

derived.role: malicious member captured independently at this revision

normalization: archive entry timestamps set to a fixed sentinel so the build is reproducible
unresolved: Per-member content digests from the SVN revision are not retained here; only the malicious member is independently hashed.
The retrieval time and digest of the SVN directory listing were not recorded at build time.
